turns.question: What share of candidates who applied in September 2026 reached the interview stage or beyond?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: there is no share or rate of applicants who reached the interview stage or beyond, and a stage count cannot be turned into a cohort share without computing it myself, which I will not do. The closest metrics are applications (candidates who applied, per day), candidates_in_stage (candidates in each hiring stage at the end of a day) and hires.
